author: D. Babusci et al.
title: Measurement of the branching fraction for the decay $K_S \to \pi \mu \nu$ with the KLOE detector
abstract: Based on a sample of 300 million $K_S$ mesons produced in $\phi \to K_L K_S$ decays recorded by the KLOE experiment at the DA$\Phi$NE $e^+ e^-$ collider we have measured the branching fraction for the decay $K_S \to \pi \mu \nu$. The $K_S$ mesons are identified by the interaction of $K_L$ mesons in the detector. A fit to the reconstructed muon mass distribution finds $7223 \pm 180$ signal events. Normalising to the $K_S \to \pi^+ \pi^-$ decay events the result for the branching fraction is $\mathcal{B}(K_S \to \pi \mu \nu) = (4.56 \pm 0.11_{\rm stat} \pm 0.17_{\rm syst}) \times 10^{-4}$. It is the first measurement of this decay mode and the result allows an independent determination of $|V_{us}|$ and a test of the lepton-flavour universality.
